one_liner: Answers "what would happen if we sent this?" by simulation — it predicts the outcome and never broadcasts a failing ticket.
what_it_does: Before anything real happens, this lamp rehearses the transaction against live chain state and predicts whether it will succeed or fail. A failing ticket was refused outright — broadcast blocked, nothing spent — while a passing ticket ran for real after its passing receipt. Proven by 2 real transactions on the Atlantic testnet, all linked below.
